newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Dominion sees encouraging gold tests.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Dominion sees encouraging gold tests.

text.p: Dominion Mining NL said Thursday that drill work was underway to follow up on encouraging test results at its Gawler joint venture in South Australia.
A further nine reverse circulation drill holes for 1,187 metres completed at the company's Challenger prospect had extended the known mineralisation, Dominion said.
Results include 17 metres at 7.7 grams of gold a tonne, 24 metres at 4.3 g/t and 11 metres at 11.5 g/t, the company said.

At the Campfire Bore prospect 30 km north-east of Challenger, two 330 metre-long zones of bedrock mineralisation, grading in excess of 1.0 g/t have been delineated within a 1,200 metre long bedrock anomaly, Dominion said.
Dominion holds 50 percent of the Gawler joint venture.
Resolute Samantha Group RSG.AX holds the other 50 percent.
